headline: Updates now happen without leaving Selects.
highlights: Selects checks for a new version each time it opens when update checks are enabled.
Download the correct Windows or Mac update directly inside Selects with visible progress.
Every download is verified by file size and SHA-256 before installation.
Choose Install & Restart to close Selects, install the verified update and reopen automatically.
notes:
- Update checking now runs quietly on every Selects launch when enabled, rather than being throttled to once per day. Offline/failing checks remain silent and never block local culling or export.
- Reworked the update-available dialog to use a short, curated headline and feature highlights instead of displaying raw Markdown release notes.
- Added in-app update downloads for both Windows x64 and Apple Silicon macOS. The correct platform package downloads to the local Selects update cache with visible progress; the browser/GitHub download page is no longer part of the normal update flow.
- Every downloaded installer is verified against both the expected byte size and SHA-256 checksum from the public release manifest before installation is enabled.
- Added **Install & Restart**. On Windows, a detached local helper waits for Selects to close, runs the per-user NSIS installer silently, and reopens Selects. On macOS, a detached helper mounts the downloaded DMG, stages/replaces the installed `.app`, restores the previous app if replacement/relaunch fails, and reopens Selects. No Apple Developer signing/notarisation is required for this private-preview workflow.
- The public release feed now carries dedicated plain-text `headline` and `highlights` fields sourced from `release-feed/update-summary.json`, keeping pre-update messaging concise while the installed build continues to provide the richer What's New screen after restart.
- Updated the Privacy Notice to v1.2 for launch-time checks and user-initiated in-app downloads/installations.
- Added 3 core scenarios for curated update presentation, SHA-256/size package verification, and browser-free Windows/macOS install-helper generation. Total suite: **48 tests**.
